info.name: TurboLedger — Phase 6 (Lending & Shares)
info.description:
Phase 6 surface through the API Gateway: loans + loanproducts, floatingrates, rates, rescheduleloans, loan-collateral-management, provisioningcategory/provisioningcriteria, delinquency buckets/ranges/actions, external-asset-owners, credit bureau configuration/integration, and shares (products/accounts/dividends) (Portfolio service).

Run the '0 - Auth' request first (requires a tenant/admin already provisioned) to populate {{token}}. Collection variables: baseUrl, tenantId, token.

Request bodies were auto-derived from the actual field reads in PortfolioService.cc; placeholder values are generic and should be adjusted to valid data (e.g. real product/client/office ids) for your environment.

Note: LoansController only wires the numeric-:loanId-addressed route family — the parallel external-id/:loanExternalId mirror that Fineract (and PortfolioService's idOrExternalId parameter) also supports is an intentional, documented scope trim to keep the route surface manageable, same as downloadtemplate/uploadtemplate CSV bulk-import and at-date/* point-in-time endpoints.
